evidence: Quint. 1.6.5: fūnis masculīnum sit an fēminīnum
terms.comment: Said of nouns: nōmen masculīnum, genus masculīnum; in the genitive of description, masculīnī generis. Of living males the adjective is mās or masculus (see male).

phrases.latin: genus, ut sī quaerātur, fūnis masculīnum sit an fēminīnum, simile illī sit pānis
phrases.english: gender, as when it is asked whether fūnis is masculine or feminine, panis may be its like

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 221, 238, 247.
